title: Rebalance bike docks with overnight van runs
body:
# Rebalance bike docks with overnight van runs

## Context
By evening the hillside docks sat empty while the riverside docks overflowed.

## Decision
Vans move bikes from full docks to empty ones between midnight and five each night, and the workshop crew checks the tyres and brakes of every bike the vans carry. The van crew plans its route from the dock fill report at eleven.

## Consequences
Two vans cover the whole network. Hillside docks start the day at least half full.
